tablet_bumper_high_rebound_tpu.structural_purpose: Heavy-duty flexible tablet auxetic bumper frame. Bumped to 5 wall loops to handle increased tablet drop momentum, ensuring the outer interlocking dovetails hold maximum shear strength.

tablet_rails_carbon_fiber_nylon.structural_purpose: High-stiffness rigid inner framework. Sliced at 100% solid concentric fill in PA-CF to bridge the wide 247mm tablet span without flexing or bowing, keeping the integrated 1.5mm wire gutters aligned perfectly.
